text: Abstract Key Innovation = First sequence transduction model based solely on attention = Dispenses with recurrence and convolutions entirely = More parallelizable with significantly less training time Performance Highlights = WMT 2014 EN-DE: 28.4 BLEU (+2+ over previous SOTA) = WMT 2014 EN-FR: 41.8 BLEU (new single-model SOTA) = Trained in 3.5 days on 8 GPUs (small fraction of previous costs)
